grounded_facts: The shadowy figure silences the steward by covering his mouth, which then vanishes.

grounded_facts: The shadowy figure dangles the steward over a fatal drop, asserting dominance and ensuring compliance through terror.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed the steward and dangled him over the edge to make it clear he couldn't defy me.

grounded_facts: The shadowy figure grabs the steward and throws him out of the window, resulting in his death upon impact with a spiked fence below.
memories.memory_text: I threw the steward out the window and watched him fall all the way down onto the spiked fence, ending him.

grounded_facts: After killing the steward, the shadowy figure slips through the window and moves into the interior.
memories.memory_text: After killing the steward, I slipped through the window and moved into the interior.

grounded_facts: When Manning asks about Hellboy and Liz, Abe downplays tensions, describing their relationship as having good and bad days.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Manning asked Abe about me and Liz, and Abe downplayed it, saying we have good days and bad like usual.

grounded_facts: Hellboy's argument with Liz culminates in an explosion that blows open his door, revealing him injured and agitated.
memories.memory_text: I was on the floor after the explosion, my back smoking and on fire, and I knew Manning and Abe had seen me like that.

grounded_facts: Hellboy shouts defiance at Liz during their argument, immediately before causing an explosion.

grounded_facts: Hellboy and Liz have a heated argument that results in a destructive explosion.
memories.memory_text: I remember yelling at Liz that I wasn't afraid of her, and then the explosion—after that, I was on the floor with my back smoking and on fire.

grounded_facts: Hellboy finds his LPs and 8-track cassettes damaged in the rubble, expressing anger over the violation of his personal rule.
memories.memory_text: I found my LPs and 8-tracks damaged in the rubble, and it made me furious because I know I told people not to touch my stuff.

grounded_facts: Liz ridicules Hellboy for owning the same album in multiple outdated formats, including 8-track.
memories.memory_text: I remember Liz making fun of me for having the same album on CD, LP, and even 8-track, like she doesn't get why it matters.

grounded_facts: Hellboy yells at Liz, blaming her for touching and damaging his music collection, citing a broken personal rule.
memories.memory_text: I yelled at Liz, telling her I have one rule—don't touch my stuff—because she messed with my music collection and ruined it.

grounded_facts: Liz expresses her need for personal space, using the missing toothbrush as a symbol of broader neglect.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Liz that she needed some space, and she used the missing toothbrush to make her point about feeling neglected.

grounded_facts: Liz locates her toothbrush buried in spilled cat kibble, leading to frustration and emotional escalation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Liz pull her toothbrush out of a pile of spilled cat kibble, and she looked really frustrated about it.

grounded_facts: An alarm sounds, halting the domestic conflict and shifting Hellboy's emotional state from anger to relief.
memories.memory_text: I was in the middle of yelling at Liz when the alarm suddenly sounded, and I felt my anger melt into relief.

memories.memory_text: I helped load our weapons onto the garbage truck, which we use as transport and mobile quarters for the team.

grounded_facts: Hellboy performs a courteous act by holding the door open for Liz as they board the truck.
memories.memory_text: I held the door open for Liz as we boarded the truck, being the gentleman I try to be.

memories.memory_text: I assured Manning I would be discreet, telling him it would be 'in and out' and that no one would see me—I gave him my word.

grounded_facts: Team gathers inside the garbage truck before entering the building, receiving final instructions.
memories.memory_text: I was in the garbage truck with Manning before we entered the building, and he asked me to be careful and use discretion during the mission in midtown.

memories.memory_text: After we gathered in the truck, I saw the team enter the TNT building to search for survivors and clues after the incident.

grounded_facts: Hellboy whispers a private offer to clean their home, including the bathroom, to improve relations with Liz.
Hellboy privately whispers over intercom to Liz, offering to clean their home, including the bathroom, as a gesture of appeasement.

grounded_facts: Liz sharply corrects Hellboy after he calls her 'babe' over the intercom.
memories.memory_text: I called Liz 'babe' over the intercom, and she sharply corrected me, saying that's not the problem and telling me not to call her that—then insisted the conversation wasn't happening now.

memories.memory_text: Abe told me he detected some activity, likely related to the creatures.

memories.memory_text: I inferred from Abe's discovery that the empty cage with the Royal Seal indicated recent creature activity.

grounded_facts: Abe uses the intercom to inform Hellboy that there are far more creatures than initially thought.
memories.memory_text: I heard Abe's voice over the intercom, telling me there were many more creatures than we first thought.

memories.memory_text: I grabbed the lever-action shotgun and started loading it when the walls and ceiling began to crack and split open around me.

memories.memory_text: I saw the wall and ceiling in the corridor bulge and crack open right in front of me, so I knew something was coming through.

grounded_facts: Abe becomes aware of surrounding unseen burrowing creatures and expresses concern.
memories.memory_text: I heard sounds of movement from unseen creatures burrowing around us.

grounded_facts: Abe advises leaving immediately and requesting additional support based on his assessment.
memories.memory_text: I was advised by Abe to leave immediately and request additional support based on his assessment.

memories.memory_text: I shot through a cracking wall and saw small mole-like bodies fleeing inside as plaster spilled out.

memories.memory_text: I called out to Abe, asking him what those mole-like creatures were because I didn't recognize them.

grounded_facts: Abe discovers a wet, gnawed human femur, confirming his suspicion about the creatures' nature.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe pick up a wet, gnawed human femur, and it confirmed how vicious these creatures really are.

grounded_facts: Abe corrects Hellboy's misperception of the floor, revealing it is not a rug but a layer of waste.
memories.memory_text: Abe told me there was no rug, correcting my assumption about the floor.

grounded_facts: Hellboy realizes the 'rug' he has been walking on is actually a thick layer of excrement.
memories.memory_text: I lifted my foot and realized I'd been walking on a thick layer of excrement.

grounded_facts: Abe explains that the creatures have a rapid digestive cycle, consuming food immediately and excreting quickly, leaving no leftovers or corpses.
memories.memory_text: I was told these creatures digest everything immediately and excrete fast, so there are no corpses because nothing's left behind.

grounded_facts: Hellboy urges Abe to clearly state what the creatures are.
memories.memory_text: I urged Abe to spit it out and tell me straight what those things are.

grounded_facts: Hellboy shouts a warning to stop Agent Marble from touching the creature.
memories.memory_text: I shouted 'No, don't-' to stop Agent Marble from touching the creature.

grounded_facts: Hellboy defends himself and another agent from swarming creatures, using shotguns and physical force to repel them.
memories.memory_text: I felt those things swarming over me, crawling toward my lips and ears, so I bellowed and fired my shotguns to protect myself and the other agent, splattering dozens against the walls.

grounded_facts: Hellboy calls out to Liz in panic, then seeing her, urges her to activate her fire powers, which she then does.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Hellboy calls out to Liz in panic, then seeing her, urges her to activate her fire powers, which she then does.

grounded_facts: Liz fully embraces her pyrokinetic ability, triggering a powerful burst of fire that transforms her into a supernova-like state.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Liz fully embraces her pyrokinetic ability, triggering a powerful burst of fire that transforms her into a supernova-like state.

grounded_facts: Manning tries to call back the reporters after the explosion, but they ignore him.
memories.memory_text: I heard Manning yelling for the reporters to come back, but they all just stampeded toward the explosion like vultures.

grounded_facts: Liz yells at Hellboy to move away from the window before he detonates the grenades.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz yelling at me to move away from the window right before I set off the grenades.

grounded_facts: Hellboy lures the tooth fairies to the window and detonates a belt of Vulcan grenades, causing a massive explosion.
memories.memory_text: I pulled out my belt of Vulcan grenades, lured the tooth fairies onto me, and detonated them all in one massive explosion.

grounded_facts: A fireball erupts from an upstairs balcony of the auction house, drawing the attention of the crowd and reporters.
memories.memory_text: I saw the fireball erupt from the balcony as I was covered in those damn fairies, right before everything went up in flames.

grounded_facts: A chaotic event at the auction house involving explosions, monster attacks, and Hellboy's intervention.
memories.memory_text: I was in the middle of it—fighting off those tooth fairies, popping them with my shotgun, arming the Vulcan grenades, and getting swarmed before the blast sent me flying.

grounded_facts: Following the explosion, Hellboy is violently launched from the upper floor window and crashes into the street below.
memories.memory_text: After the blast, I was launched like a cannonball out the window and crashed into the street below, still covered in those damn fairies.

grounded_facts: Liz uses her radio to ask Hellboy if he is alright, showing concern.
Liz uses her radio to call Hellboy, expressing concern for his well-being.
memories.memory_text: I was told over the radio that Liz was asking if I was alright, showing she was concerned about me.

grounded_facts: Liz and Abe move to the window and look down, indicating observation of an external event or situation.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Liz and Abe moved to the window to look down, probably observing something happening outside.

grounded_facts: Hellboy makes a casual remark to Manning acknowledging their public exposure after the incident.
memories.memory_text: I made a casual remark to Manning, shrugging it off—'I guess we're out now'—after realizing our secret was out.

grounded_facts: Hellboy kills several fairies in front of a crowd and cameras, making their existence and his role undeniable and public.
memories.memory_text: I took down those fairies in front of the crowd, and I could see the cameras flashing everywhere—Manning looked like he wanted to vanish, but I just shrugged and said we're out now, because there was no hiding it anymore.

grounded_facts: Hellboy's public appearance the previous night has led to widespread media coverage, making him a known public figure.
memories.memory_text: I saw all the news channels showing footage of my outing last night, and I was grinning at the camera and even signing autographs.

grounded_facts: Manning expresses anger and frustration over Hellboy's public appearance, calling it a disaster.
memories.memory_text: I heard Manning yell that my public appearance was a disaster, worse than Cheney with a shotgun, and he made sure I knew he was furious.

grounded_facts: After reading hate mail directed at them, Liz glares at Hellboy, blaming him for the backlash.
memories.memory_text: I saw Liz glare at me after she read the hate mail, like she was blaming me for the backlash.

grounded_facts: Hellboy is replaced as team leader effective immediately, with a new leader to be introduced at a meeting.
memories.memory_text: Manning told me directly that I'm no longer team leader as of today and that there's a new leader coming, and he repeated it so I couldn't miss it.

grounded_facts: Manning announces an urgent meeting to introduce the new team leader at 0900.
memories.memory_text: Manning told me we're to meet the new team leader at the conference room at 0900, and he said 'Now' to emphasize it.

grounded_facts: Johann Kraus is introduced as the new public face of the BPRD, replacing Hellboy due to political pressure after recent events.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Manning that Johann Kraus is replacing me as the public face of the BPRD because Washington wants a change after recent events.

grounded_facts: A meeting takes place in the BPRD security pound where Hellboy and Manning encounter Johann Kraus for the first time.
memories.memory_text: I was in the BPRD security pound when I first saw Johann Kraus during a meeting with Manning.

grounded_facts: Hellboy repeatedly voices discomfort and prejudice regarding Germans, triggered by the introduction of Johann Kraus.
memories.memory_text: I said out loud that Kraus being German makes me nervous, because Germans make me uncomfortable.

grounded_facts: Johann Kraus takes Liz's hand and bows, introducing himself in a polite and charming manner.
memories.memory_text: I saw Johann Kraus take Liz's hand and bow to her, saying 'Johann Kraus, at your service' in a polite way that seemed calculated to charm her.

grounded_facts: Hellboy whispers a sarcastic comment about Johann Kraus's 'open face,' mocking his glass bubble head.
memories.memory_text: I whispered a sarcastic remark about his 'open face' when I saw his glass bubble head turn toward us, mocking how he was trying to impress everyone.

grounded_facts: Johann clarifies his ability to inhabit organic and mechanical entities using protoplasmic emanation, in response to Hellboy's skepticism.
memories.memory_text: I questioned Johann about how he could inhabit organic bodies, and he told me he uses protoplasmic emanation to briefly control and reactivate both mechanical and organic entities.

grounded_facts: Johann translates the Fairy's furious babbling into an insult directed at Hellboy, calling him rude, brutish, and not too bright.
memories.memory_text: Johann told me the reanimated Fairy called me rude, brutish, and not too bright.

grounded_facts: Through Johann's reactivation, the Fairy recalls a peculiar noise associated with the Troll market, specifically identifying it as Troll language.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Johann that the Fairy remembered a peculiar noise from where it was last traded—a market sound he identified as Troll language.

grounded_facts: After recalling the clue, the Fairy collapses and dies due to Johann losing control over its limbic system.
memories.memory_text: I saw the fairy start babbling and grow weak after it gave up the clue, and then its cheekbones hollowed before it collapsed—I realized Johann must have lost control of it.

grounded_facts: A focused gathering where Johann reanimates a dead Fairy to extract information about its origins and last known location.
Johann uses his protoplasmic emanation to briefly reactivate a dead Fairy's neural system, allowing it to remember and communicate.
memories.memory_text: I watched Johann pull out a dead, singed Fairy and use some protoplasmic tendrils from his fingers to reactivate it; the thing snarled at me, started babbling, then collapsed as the ectoplasm returned to Johann.

grounded_facts: Based on the Fairy's memory and Johann's knowledge, the team concludes they have enough information to pursue the Troll market.
memories.memory_text: I was told that between the Fairy's memory and Johann's knowledge, we had enough to go after the Troll market, so I accepted it was time to move.

grounded_facts: Hellboy questions Johann's claimed German origin due to his lack of a German accent.
memories.memory_text: I asked Johann how he could claim to be German when he didn't have a German accent—I didn't buy his act.

grounded_facts: Abe reveals and tests a pair of technologically complex goggles, indicating readiness for the mission.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe pull out and test a pair of complex goggles made of copper and glass, buzzing with activity, as part of getting ready for the mission.

grounded_facts: Abe states he likes Johann and compliments his voice as commanding and soothing.
memories.memory_text: I heard Abe say he likes Johann and thinks his voice is commanding and soothing, which just made me more annoyed.

grounded_facts: Hellboy calls Abe a jerk for supporting Johann.
memories.memory_text: I told Abe he was a jerk for supporting Johann, because I couldn't believe he actually liked that guy.

grounded_facts: Hellboy calls Johann a moron and mocks his leadership claim.
Hellboy criticizes Johann's self-importance and dismisses his role as 'the brains of the operation,' showing resistance to his authority.
memories.memory_text: I called Johann a moron and mocked his claim of being 'the brains of the operation' because I think he's full of himself and doesn't deserve to lead us.

grounded_facts: Team members prepare their gear and discuss Johann's role while suiting up in the garage area.
memories.memory_text: I was suiting up in the garage with Liz and Abe, and we talked about Johann's role while getting our gear ready.

Liz suggests Hellboy's anger toward Johann is due to feeling threatened.
memories.memory_text: I remember Liz telling me that I feel threatened by Johann and that my anger comes from insecurity, not principle.

grounded_facts: Hellboy remains behind, engaging in deep thought after the group moves on.
memories.memory_text: I stayed behind after the others left, taking a moment to think deeply about everything that had just happened.

memories.memory_text: I remember riding in silence with Liz in the garbage truck lab, trying to figure things out before speaking up, and how our private moment turned tense as we argued about the media and what it meant.

grounded_facts: Hellboy challenges Liz's implication that he feels threatened, questioning who could threaten him and expressing confusion over her concerns.
Hellboy reacts defensively to Liz's criticism, challenging her claim that he feels threatened
memories.memory_text: I laughed and challenged Liz when she suggested I felt threatened, asking her who could possibly threaten me and pushing back when she said it was about the whole thing with the TV and reporters.

grounded_facts: Hellboy physically closes the distance to Liz, signaling concern and desire to connect
Hellboy gently urges Liz to open up about what is troubling her
memories.memory_text: I moved closer to Liz and asked her if something else was bothering her, wanting to make sure she knew I was there for her.

grounded_facts: Liz reveals her deep discomfort with being watched, equating it with feeling like a freak, and attributes this to Hellboy's recent public actions.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz tell me she doesn't like being watched and feels like a freak when people do, and she linked it to what I've done lately.

memories.memory_text: I was overwhelmed when the doors opened and hundreds of reporters and cameras from all over the world flooded in, flashing and shouting all at once.

grounded_facts: Reporters and camera crews from around the world suddenly invade the lab, overwhelming Hellboy and Liz with flashes and noise.
memories.memory_text: I was overwhelmed when reporters and camera crews from all over the world suddenly stormed the lab, flashing lights and shouting all around me and Liz.

memories.memory_text: I was moved through Brooklyn at night in a covert operation, with agents cordoning off the streets and holding the press back as we went.

memories.memory_text: I saw crowds gathering and pushing forward to catch a glimpse of me, with some people running alongside the truck carrying signs that showed both support and hatred.

grounded_facts: Manning suggests Hellboy avoid signing autographs during the transport.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Manning to avoid signing autographs during the transport.

memories.memory_text: I rejected Manning's suggestion and told him the garbage truck makes the wrong statement about who we are, because I felt it disrespected our identity.

grounded_facts: Hellboy prepares to attack the crowd after being hit and insulted, but is stopped by Liz.
memories.memory_text: I got ready to pummel the crowd after they hit me with an egg and started roaring, but Liz stepped in and stopped me.

grounded_facts: Liz physically and verbally stops Hellboy from attacking the crowd, urging restraint.
memories.memory_text: I felt the rage building and was about to attack, but Liz physically held me back and told me to calm down, saying 'Shh! Give him a chance...'

memories.memory_text: I was on the Brooklyn Bridge when Johann gave this emotional speech, asking the public and reporters for respect and a chance to prove himself and our team worthy of a place in the world.

memories.memory_text: I thought Johann's speech was so corny, but then I saw the crowd—including Liz and Abe—actually applauding him, and I was completely stunned.

memories.memory_text: I heard Abe say Johann has a nice voice, and it stood out to me in that moment.

memories.memory_text: I saw Johann shift back to mission mode right after, telling us we had work to do.

memories.memory_text: I announced we were moving in and signaled the team to advance.

grounded_facts: Hellboy, Johann, and Abe follow the Bag Lady to a service corridor as part of their investigation.
memories.memory_text: I followed the Bag Lady into the service corridor with Johann and Abe as part of our investigation.

memories.memory_text: I whispered to the group that maybe we could bowl a few frames.

grounded_facts: Hellboy suggests bowling a few frames as a possible activity.
memories.memory_text: I suggested we could bowl a few frames as a way to hang out together.

grounded_facts: Abe displays his webbed fingers and explains that bowling balls give him trouble.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe show his webbed fingers and explain that bowling balls give him trouble.

Hellboy suggests having a beer and addresses Johann directly.
memories.memory_text: I suggested to Johann that we have a beer, trying to keep things light and friendly after we got out.

memories.memory_text: I saw Johann use his ecto-tendrils to enter the lock, manipulate the internal gears, and open it safely, revealing a stone staircase underneath.

grounded_facts: Hellboy, Abe, and Johann arrive in the basement and uncover the concealed entrance to Troll Market through optical manipulation and lock activation.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Hellboy, Abe, and Johann arrive in the basement and uncover the concealed entrance to Troll Market through optical manipulation and lock activation.

memories.memory_text: Abe tried to tell me something urgent over the radio, calling me 'Brother Red,' but I told him not to bother me right then.

memories.memory_text: I took down the Berserker with one uppercut, sending it flying and knocking its iron shoes loose—I didn't hold back.

grounded_facts: Johann and Hellboy confront the shop owner about the royal seal, leading to a violent encounter with the Berserker.
memories.memory_text: Johann and I confronted the shop owner about the royal seal, and when he turned pale and things went south, I had to step in and deal with the Berserker that showed up.

grounded_facts: Hellboy physically slaps the shop owner to force him to talk.

grounded_facts: Under coercion from Hellboy, the shop owner reveals rumors of a revolt against the human world.
memories.memory_text: I was told there are rumors of a revolt against the human world after I got the shop owner to talk.

memories.memory_text: I used my belt locator to contact Abe and asked for his location.

memories.memory_text: I remember Abe was watching the Princess through a window as she bought some kind of silver and crystal cylinder from a shop, and when I tried to check in with him, I could tell something was off.

memories.memory_text: I burst into the map shop with Johann, smashing the door and taking down the guards, which clearly ruined the diplomatic tone of the meeting.

memories.memory_text: I burst into the map shop with Johann, seeing guards down, and swatted away those annoying bugs before the Princess told me to apologize for my entrance.

memories.memory_text: The Princess demanded to know where I got the ancient seal, looking straight at me with suspicion.

memories.memory_text: I saw the Elemental smashing through the corridor behind me like a wrecking ball, destroying each section as I ran to escape.

memories.memory_text: I stepped out onto a ledge ten stories up to get out of the Elemental's reach.

grounded_facts: Hellboy makes a running leap across the alley to another roof, barely grabbing the cornice and pulling himself up.
memories.memory_text: I made a running leap across the alley and barely grabbed the cornice, pulling myself up just in time.

memories.memory_text: I saw Liz burn the Elemental's roots while Johann used the cable to trip it, and when it lost balance, it threw me into the air—but I managed to swing back and land on its back.

grounded_facts: Hellboy strikes the Elemental from behind, causing it to fall forward and impale itself on a bridge spire, killing it and seemingly killing the Prince as well.

memories.memory_text: I fought the Elemental at the Brooklyn Bridge, got thrown into the air, swung back onto its back, and saw it impale itself on the spire—then I watched as its body transformed the city with trees and moss.

memories.memory_text: I saw Abe emerge from the river, bleeding but alive, and then Liz and Johann rushed to him and they all embraced, laughing and holding each other tightly.

memories.memory_text: I stood off to the side watching them celebrate Abe's return, and I felt jealous and alone, like I didn't belong in that moment.

grounded_facts: A tense verbal and physical exchange between Hellboy and Johann occurs in the locker room, triggered by Hellboy's jealousy and culminating in violence and supernatural retaliation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Johann in the locker room, and when he questioned me, I confronted him — I raised my stone fist and smashed his glass head, but then his suit collapsed and the lockers came alive, slamming me like I was nothing.

memories.memory_text: I saw Johann's suit collapse and his ectoplasmic form slip into the lockers after I hit it, then his spirit emerged from them and floated away, showing he could move fast and pass through solid things.

memories.memory_text: I hit eject on Abe's CD player, pulled out the Barry Manilow disc, and said, 'What's happening to you??' then teased him by saying love doesn't sound like a good thing and told him he needs to get out more.

grounded_facts: A private, emotionally charged conversation between Hellboy and Abe late at night in the library.
memories.memory_text: I stayed with Abe after he told me he was in love, and even though I gave him a hard time, I ended up sitting with him, drinking a beer, and we both sang along to that sappy music until we were teary-eyed.

memories.memory_text: I remember that An emergency situation unfolds at the BPRD garage involving alarms and dead agents.

grounded_facts: Hellboy and Manning discover the bodies of several dead agents on the loading dock.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Hellboy and Manning discover the bodies of several dead agents on the loading dock.

grounded_facts: Hellboy, Abe, Liz, and Johann rush past Manning and enter the building.
memories.memory_text: I rushed past Manning with Abe, Liz, and Johann to get into the building fast.

grounded_facts: Hellboy takes the lead while moving through the BPRD corridor amid chaos.
memories.memory_text: I took the lead moving down the corridor while everyone was scrambling around me.

grounded_facts: Abe impulsively rushes toward the Princess when he sees her bound, attempting to reach her despite danger.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe rush toward the bound Princess the moment we arrived, and I shouted at him to stop—then had to grab and hold him back when he tried again.

grounded_facts: Johann suggests that Hellboy use a flail from the broken display case to gain advantage in combat.
memories.memory_text: I remember Johann telling me to arm myself and use the flail during the fight, but I didn't listen—I prefer fighting bare-handed.

grounded_facts: Hellboy confronts the Prince directly, initiating a duel to de-escalate the standoff and protect the others.
memories.memory_text: I stepped up to the Prince and told him to start with me, then I moved in fast—feinting left, going right, and whipping my tail at him. I got him with a hard punch and followed up with a brutal combo, knocking him down. For a second, I turned to check on Abe, but then the Prince yanked his spear free and I felt it tear through me—I couldn't stay upright and collapsed, hearing Liz scream as I went down.

grounded_facts: During the fight, the Prince stabs Hellboy in the chest with his spear, breaking off the blade and causing severe injury.
memories.memory_text: I felt the Prince's spear pierce my chest, and when he yanked it, the blade broke off inside me—I couldn't stay standing and collapsed as Liz and Johann caught me.

grounded_facts: After escaping, the Prince declares that the Princess will remain in his possession unless the crown is delivered to him.
memories.memory_text: I remember the Prince holding up the Princess and declaring that she'd remain with him unless they brought him the crown—his voice cold, demanding, like he truly believed it was his right.

grounded_facts: After wounding Hellboy, the Prince takes the Princess and flees with his trolls, issuing a ransom demand for her return.
memories.memory_text: I remember the Prince wounding me with his spear, the pain sharp as he broke the blade off in my chest—I collapsed, and through the haze, I saw him take the Princess and flee with his trolls after shouting his demand.

grounded_facts: A tense standoff escalates into a physical duel between Hellboy and the Prince, culminating in injury and escape.
memories.memory_text: I stepped forward and challenged the Prince directly, fighting him with my fists and tail until he got past my guard and drove his spear into my chest—I felt it go in before he and his trolls escaped.

grounded_facts: A crisis meeting in the medical bay centered on saving Hellboy after being impaled by a magical spear.
Hellboy is impaled by a magical spear that is moving toward his heart.
memories.memory_text: I remember lying on the operating table, barely conscious, while Abe examined the spear stuck in my chest — I could feel it move deeper when he touched it, and everyone was focused on saving me.

grounded_facts: Liz tells Abe to stop studying and remove the spear immediately.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz yell at Abe to stop studying and just pull the spear out of me right away.

grounded_facts: Abe determines the spear is made of a magical alloy that reacts to touch by moving deeper into HB's body.
memories.memory_text: I heard Abe say that the spear is made of a magical alloy and that every time he touches it, it moves closer to my heart.

grounded_facts: Abe tries to demonstrate the spear's behavior to Liz.
memories.memory_text: I remember Abe trying to show Liz how the spear reacts when touched, but she refused to come closer.

grounded_facts: Liz turns to Johann, insisting they must take action to save HB.
memories.memory_text: I saw Liz turn to Johann and insist we had to do something to save me.

grounded_facts: The team decides they must find the Prince or someone who can reverse the magic on the spear.
memories.memory_text: I was told we need to find the Prince or someone who can reverse the magic on the spear.

grounded_facts: Liz insists on going after the Prince to force him to reverse the spell.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz say we should go after the Prince and force him to reverse the spell.

grounded_facts: Johann states that the Prince will demand the gold piece in exchange for help.
memories.memory_text: I was told Johann said the Prince would demand the gold piece in exchange for helping.

grounded_facts: Liz declares they should find and give the gold piece to the Prince if needed.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz say we should find the gold piece and give it to the Prince if we have to.

grounded_facts: Abe uses the cylinder case to reveal previously invisible glyphs, coordinates, and a silhouette of a twisted tree on the map, identifying Renvyle as the birthplace of the Princess and her brother.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe use the cylinder case to reveal hidden glyphs, coordinates, and a twisted tree on the map, and I inferred that Renvyle must be the birthplace of the Princess and her brother since he said they held it sacred.

grounded_facts: A formal meeting in the conference room where the team discusses the map and next steps regarding the mission and Hellboy's fate.
memories.memory_text: I was in the conference room during the team meeting where they discussed the map and debated what to do about my fate, and I remember Liz's anger when Johann sided with Manning.

grounded_facts: Hellboy comforts Liz by telling her not to worry and that things will be alright.
Hellboy, despite being in pain, tells Liz that everything will be alright, showing emotional support.
memories.memory_text: I was in pain and leaning against the doorway, but I smiled weakly at Liz and told her not to worry, that it's all going to be alright.

grounded_facts: Abe agrees with Liz and proposes they act together as a trio, rejecting Manning's authority.
Abe declares support for Liz's position and proposes the three of them face the situation together, rejecting Manning's authority.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe tell Liz that they should screw Manning and do this together as a trio, and I remember him saying they'd make it alright.

grounded_facts: Hellboy enters the passenger compartment of the BPRD airplane.
memories.memory_text: I climbed up into the passenger compartment of the BPRD airplane.

grounded_facts: The scene takes place as characters board or are present on the BPRD airplane during night.
memories.memory_text: It was night as I boarded the plane, evident from the dark surroundings and Liz's presence inside.

grounded_facts: Liz smiles down at Hellboy as he climbs into the plane.
memories.memory_text: I saw Liz smiling down at me as I came in.

grounded_facts: Liz confronts Johann upon his arrival, preemptively telling him not to interfere with their plans.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz tell Johann not to try to stop us when he arrived.

grounded_facts: Johann announces that he has reconsidered and believes they can proceed to save Hellboy, citing the Prince's lack of the gold crown as a key strategic advantage.
Johann counters Liz's warning by affirming he does not intend to stop them and instead offers a plan to save Hellboy.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Johann that he had reconsidered and wanted to help save me, saying the Prince's army wasn't a threat without the gold crown.

grounded_facts: Johann sits in the co-pilot seat and connects with the controls, successfully starting the engines.
memories.memory_text: I saw Johann sit in the co-pilot seat, connect with the controls, and start the engines.

grounded_facts: Abe is seen in the cockpit and raises his webbed hand to wave goodbye to those outside.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe in the cockpit and he raised his webbed hand to wave goodbye, confirming he was really there and meant to leave.

grounded_facts: Hellboy weakly groans and asks Liz about their location, indicating he is regaining awareness.
Hellboy, weakly conscious, asks Liz where they are.
memories.memory_text: I weakly groaned and asked Liz where we were, still coming to and feeling disoriented.

grounded_facts: Liz tells Hellboy they are near the ocean and will make him well on the island.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz tell me we were near the ocean and that they’d make me well on the island.

grounded_facts: Liz urges Abe to try inserting the mapcase into the tree slot, showing urgency and support.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz urge Abe to try inserting the mapcase into the tree slot, and I could feel her urgency as she pushed us to move forward.

grounded_facts: Johann warns Abe to remember the dangers of the world they are about to enter before activating the portal.
memories.memory_text: I told Abe to remember the dangers of the world we were about to enter before he activated the portal, because I knew it would be unlike anything we'd faced.

grounded_facts: Abe inserts and twists the crystal cylinder containing the map into a roundish slot in the tree, activating the portal.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe insert and twist the crystal cylinder into the tree's slot, and then the tree came alive, pulling its roots from the ground to form a swaying archway.

grounded_facts: A coordinated effort at the gnarled tree to activate a portal to the Fairy World using the mapcase as a key.
memories.memory_text: I was there at the gnarled tree with the team, and we worked together to activate a portal to the Fairy World using the mapcase as a key, then walked through when the roots formed an arch.

grounded_facts: The group enters through the activated tree and arrives in the Fairy World, a transformed landscape under perpetual night.
memories.memory_text: I walked under the arch of the living tree roots with the team and entered the Fairy World, a strange, twisted landscape glowing with pale colors under a perpetual night sky.

grounded_facts: The crow informs the group that the goblin will not want money or ordinary items.
The crow interrupts the negotiation to inform the group that the goblin will not accept monetary or material goods as payment.
memories.memory_text: I was told the goblin wouldn't want money or any ordinary items as payment when we tried to negotiate our passage.

grounded_facts: The goblin swiftly cuts open Hellboy's bandage to expose the embedded speartip in his chest, demanding it as payment for passage.
memories.memory_text: I felt the goblin slash open my bandage with a knife, exposing the speartip still lodged in my chest wound.

grounded_facts: The goblin explicitly demands the speartip embedded in Hellboy's chest as the price for ferrying the group across the inlet.
memories.memory_text: I heard the goblin demand the speartip in my chest as the price for ferrying us across the inlet.

grounded_facts: Liz pushes the goblin away from Hellboy after he exposes the wound, showing protective aggression.
memories.memory_text: I saw Liz rush to my side and push the goblin away when he got too close to my wound, like she was ready to fight him to protect me.

grounded_facts: The goblin offers to ferry the group across the inlet, initiating the negotiation.
A structured interaction between the group and a goblin ferryman to secure passage across the inlet to Renvyle.
memories.memory_text: I was with the group when the goblin offered to ferry us across the inlet to Renvyle, and I saw how the negotiation began with his question and our responses, including Johann offering his belt and the goblin eventually demanding the speartip from my chest.

grounded_facts: After learning the speartip is dangerous to touch, the goblin suggests they must go to the Angel of Death, implying a necessary next step.
memories.memory_text: I heard the goblin realize the speartip was dangerous and then say we must go to the Angel of Death, like it was the only way forward.

grounded_facts: The Angel of Death identifies Hellboy as Anung-un-Rama and claims involvement in his arrival into the world.
memories.memory_text: I remember the Angel of Death recognizing me as Anung-un-Rama and telling me she helped bring me into this world.

grounded_facts: The Angel of Death cautions Liz that saving Hellboy will bring great sorrow to her and the world, referencing his apocalyptic destiny.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Angel of Death warn Liz that saving me would bring her and the world great sorrow because of my destiny.

grounded_facts: The Angel of Death removes the spear tip embedded in Hellboy's chest, healing him and allowing him to regain consciousness.
memories.memory_text: I felt the Angel of Death pull the spear tip from my chest with tongs, and I cried out in pain before my eyes fluttered open again.

grounded_facts: A formal and ritualistic healing conducted by the Angel of Death in her cave, involving the removal of a cursed spear from Hellboy’s body.
memories.memory_text: I felt the Angel of Death remove the cursed spear from my body in a ritual healing, and I remember crying out in pain before she told me to sleep and that my strength would return.

grounded_facts: The Goblin signals insistently for its payment after ferrying the group, prompting Johann to interpret its intent.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Goblin jumping and hissing, pointing at the spear tip, and I heard Johann say our ferry captain wanted his payment.

grounded_facts: The Angel of Death tosses the extracted spear tip to the Goblin, fulfilling its role as ferry captain and payment recipient.
memories.memory_text: I watched the Angel of Death toss the spear tip to the Goblin, who caught it and ran out.

grounded_facts: A quiet moment outside the Angel of Death's hut where Hellboy recovers physically and emotionally reconnects with Liz before the final mission.
memories.memory_text: I was sitting outside the Angel of Death's hut, bandaged and sipping tea, just taking a moment to look at Liz while she smiled, feeling the quiet between us.

grounded_facts: Hellboy asks Liz if he is still a good man, showing emotional dependence and need for affirmation.
Hellboy asks Liz if he is still a good man, showing vulnerability and seeking emotional validation.
memories.memory_text: I asked Liz if I'm still a good man—pleaded with her, really—because I needed to hear it from her, needed to know that despite everything, she still believes in me.

grounded_facts: Johann announces that he and Abe have found the entrance to the Golden Army's resting place, advancing the plot toward the final confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I remember Johann announcing that he and Abe had found the entrance to the Golden Army's resting place, like it was some big revelation.

grounded_facts: Johann tells Hellboy to stay behind and rest, implying lack of trust or concern for stability.
memories.memory_text: I was told to stay behind and rest, as if I couldn't handle myself, which felt more like a lack of trust than concern.

grounded_facts: Hellboy refuses to be left behind and mocks Johann, asserting his intent to monitor him.
Despite being told to rest, Hellboy insists on joining the mission to the Golden Army, asserting his role in the team.
memories.memory_text: I refused to be left behind and told Johann I wasn't going to call him in the morning—like hell I'd let him run this mission without me watching his back.

grounded_facts: The team arrives at the bluff overlooking the sea, identifying the cave entrance half a mile ahead as the target location.
memories.memory_text: I followed Johann, Liz, and Abe along the bluff high over the sea, and when Johann pointed to the cave entrance half a mile ahead, I saw it clearly as our target.

grounded_facts: Abe points to the violent sea and warns Hellboy that they must jump in, questioning if he can make it.
memories.memory_text: Abe pointed at the violent sea and told me we’d have to jump in, then asked if I could make it, clearly worried about my condition.

grounded_facts: Abe and Hellboy express surprise at the absence of expected security at the cave entrance.
memories.memory_text: I noticed the entrance was strangely unprotected, and Abe and I both wondered why there wasn't more security around.

grounded_facts: Hellboy overpowers Wink, breaks the chain, and throws him off the cliff into the sea.
memories.memory_text: I overpowered Wink, snapped the chain around my neck, and threw him off the cliff into the sea.

grounded_facts: Wink ambushes Hellboy with a chain and mace, initiating combat.
memories.memory_text: I was suddenly ambushed by Wink, who wrapped a chain around my neck and started attacking me with a mace, but I managed to snap the chain, get the upper hand, and throw him overboard.

grounded_facts: Hellboy's side wound reopens during or after the fight with Wink.
memories.memory_text: I noticed my side wound had reopened and I was bleeding after the fight.

grounded_facts: After the fight, Abe notices Hellboy is bleeding; Hellboy tells him not to say anything and to keep moving.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe notice I was bleeding, and I told him not to say anything and to keep moving.

grounded_facts: The team enters the sea and swims into the cave entrance underwater.
memories.memory_text: I entered the water with Liz and followed Johann as he led us swimming into the dark cave entrance.

grounded_facts: The team approaches and prepares to enter the sea cave leading to the enemy base, encountering an ambush and entering underwater.
memories.memory_text: I saw Johann plunge into the rough seas and disappear into the cave’s darkness, so I jumped in with Liz right after, knowing we had to follow him underwater to get inside.

grounded_facts: Hellboy helps Johann unlock an underwater iron lock, enabling access to a hidden stairwell.
memories.memory_text: I used all my strength to grip the rusted wheel underwater and finally turn it, helping Johann unlock the iron mechanism.

grounded_facts: Hellboy's wound reopens during the underwater effort, causing blood loss and physical distress.
memories.memory_text: I felt my wound tear open underwater and saw my blood swirling out, the bandage floating away as I struggled to keep moving.

grounded_facts: A coordinated effort by the group to unlock and access a submerged passage leading into the cliff.
memories.memory_text: I saw Johann dive down first to inspect the lock, and together we worked to open it, even though I could feel my wound straining under the effort.

grounded_facts: The trio climbs a hidden stairwell carved into the cliff, moving deeper into the cave system.
memories.memory_text: I climbed the hidden stairwell with the others, using a light stick to see as we went deeper into the cave. I had to stop and lean against the wall for a moment, dabbing at my chest because the wound had reopened and I could feel the blood seeping out.

grounded_facts: Liz voices worry about Hellboy's condition, indicating the group should rest.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz say we should rest, but I didn't think it was necessary.

grounded_facts: Hellboy refuses to acknowledge his injury and insists he is fine, pushing past the others.
memories.memory_text: I told them I was fine and pushed forward, even though it hurt.

grounded_facts: Hellboy's repeated thumping on a mechanical soldier causes it to fall, initiating a chain reaction that topples a line of golden soldiers.
memories.memory_text: I tapped on one of those mechanical soldiers out of curiosity, and when I thumped it harder, it rocked and fell, setting off a chain reaction that made the whole line collapse like dominoes—I barely had time to pull Liz aside before the wave of crashing metal reached us.

grounded_facts: Prince observes Hellboy's wound and comments on it with disdain.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Prince sneer at my wound, saying I was bleeding and that machines never feel the zest of combat like I do.

grounded_facts: Prince demands the remaining gold segment, revealing he already has two pieces.
memories.memory_text: I was told the Prince demanded the final crown piece, claiming we were foolish for not having it, after revealing he already had two.

grounded_facts: The BPRD team confronts Prince Nuada in the underground arena after triggering the collapse of golden soldiers.
memories.memory_text: After the soldiers stopped falling, Prince Nuada appeared at the front of the wreckage, walking past the broken line while kicking aside weapons, and I could feel the tension rise—we all knew a confrontation was coming, especially when Abe arrived with the last crown piece and I called out to him.

grounded_facts: Abe arrives with the last gold segment and hands it to Prince Nuada in exchange for the Princess's safety.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe arrive with the last gold piece and hand it to Prince Nuada to save the Princess—I called out to him as he did it.

grounded_facts: Prince Nuada assembles the crown and declares himself commander, reactivating the entire golden army.
memories.memory_text: I watched Prince Nuada assemble the crown and place it on his head, then command the golden army to rise—I saw the soldiers reactivate and heard him order them to kill us.

grounded_facts: Johann exits his suit and takes control of a mechanical soldier to fight the others.
memories.memory_text: I saw Johann unzip his suit and his ghostly form flow out, taking over one of the golden soldiers—I watched it spin and start tearing into the others, chopping them apart until their broken pieces littered the floor, and then I saw him slip back into his suit.

grounded_facts: After stabbing herself, the Princess shares a final look with her brother, conveying love and hatred.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Princess stab herself and then share a final look with her brother — I could feel the love and hatred between them.

grounded_facts: The Princess stabs herself in the arm, exploiting her psychic link to wound the Prince and give Hellboy an advantage.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Princess step forward and stab herself in the arm with a dagger, and right then the Prince clutched his own arm, bleeding—I realized she used their psychic link to hurt him and give me an opening.

grounded_facts: Hellboy formally challenges Prince Nuada for command of the golden army, leading to a sword duel.
memories.memory_text: I challenged Prince Nuada for command of the golden army, and when he picked up his sword, I knew there was no turning back—we fought fiercely, and though I grew weak and my sword trembled, I managed to disarm him and hold him at blade-point, only for him to impale himself and collapse alongside his sister.

grounded_facts: Abe begs Hellboy not to challenge the Prince, fearing for the Princess.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe pleading with me not to fight the Prince, and every time I got a clear shot, he looked at me with fear—especially for the Princess—so I held back.

grounded_facts: The Princess dies after her psychic bond with her brother is severed, sharing a final moment with Abe.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Princess step forward and stab herself with her dagger; Abe rushed to her and held her as she died in his arms, telling him they'd find each other again before turning to dust.

grounded_facts: After gaining advantage from Princess's sacrifice, Hellboy disarms Prince and impales him when Prince commits suicide by charging the blade.
memories.memory_text: I raised my sword and disarmed the Prince after Princess's sacrifice gave me the opening; when I declared victory, he charged forward and impaled himself on my blade, and I could do nothing to stop it.

grounded_facts: After being impaled, Prince Nuada dies while delivering a prophetic warning to Hellboy about humanity's betrayal.
memories.memory_text: I saw Prince Nuada die after I impaled him, and before he turned to dust, he told me the humans would betray me, that I was living a lie — his last words still echo in my mind.

grounded_facts: Hellboy destroys the crown piece by piece, causing the golden army to collapse, and the final segment explodes, destroying the remainder.
memories.memory_text: I ripped the crown apart piece by piece, and with each section I destroyed, another division of the golden army collapsed into scrap—until the last segment exploded in my hands and the rest of the army disintegrated.

grounded_facts: The immediate aftermath following the deaths of Prince and Princess, including the destruction of the crown and army.
memories.memory_text: After the Prince and Princess turned to dust, I picked up the crown, examined it, and realized its power—I tore it apart piece by piece, watching entire divisions of the golden army crumble into scrap, until the last segment exploded in my hands and I told the remaining creatures to leave and stay in the shadows where they belonged.

grounded_facts: Hellboy orders the troll guards to leave and remain in the shadows.
memories.memory_text: I told the troll guards to leave and stay in the shadows where they belong.

grounded_facts: Hellboy deliberately avoids making eye contact with Liz as they walk together, indicating emotional distance or tension.
memories.memory_text: I walked beside Liz but kept my eyes forward, deliberately avoiding her glance.

grounded_facts: Abe expresses appreciation to Manning for past support before resigning.
memories.memory_text: I heard Abe tell Manning, 'I want to thank you, too. For all you've done for us over the years,' and I could tell he meant it.

grounded_facts: A meeting between the departing team and Manning's surveillance group results in resignations and departure.
memories.memory_text: I saw Manning and his agents watching us, and when Abe thanked Manning and handed over his gear, I knew we were all leaving the BPRD for good.

grounded_facts: Abe formally resigns from the team by handing over his gunbelt and equipment pack to an agent.
memories.memory_text: I watched Abe give his gunbelt and pack to one of Manning's agents and say 'I quit,' and then I pulled out my own gun and dropped my pack too.

grounded_facts: Hellboy removes his pack and declares his resignation, though he keeps his weapon.
memories.memory_text: I looked at Abe, took out the Samaritan, and shrugged off my pack—I said it looked like I was resigning, but I made sure to keep my weapon.

grounded_facts: Liz makes physical contact with Hellboy, signaling unity and emotional support.
Liz makes physical contact with Hellboy and walks away with him and Abe, indicating alignment with their decision.
memories.memory_text: I felt Liz take my arm and hold on tightly as we walked away together with Abe, her touch telling me she was with me, united in this choice.

grounded_facts: A quiet moment by the ocean where Liz and Hellboy discuss their future together after a journey
memories.memory_text: I sat beside Liz on the mossy rocks by the ocean, feeling the calm after our journey as we talked about our future.

grounded_facts: Liz suggests moving to a rural area for a peaceful life, implying a long-term future together
memories.memory_text: Liz told me she wanted us to move to the country, with clean air and green hills, and I could hear how much she wanted that life with me.

grounded_facts: Liz reveals to Hellboy that she is pregnant, introducing a new familial future and shifting their relationship dynamic.
memories.memory_text: I remember when Liz told me she was pregnant—she said, 'Our baby, that's who!'—and it hit me that we were going to start a family.

grounded_facts: Hellboy shows immense joy upon learning about the baby
memories.memory_text: I felt my grin spread across my face when I realized I was going to be a father, and that joy—that pure moment—is one I’ll never forget.

grounded_facts: Johann Kraus is introduced as the new public face of the BPRD, replacing Hellboy due to political pressure after recent events.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Johann Kraus would be the new public face of the BPRD, replacing me due to political pressure after recent events, and that he is a physical medium and head of the European branch.

grounded_facts: A meeting takes place in the BPRD security pound where Hellboy and Manning encounter Johann Kraus for the first time.
memories.memory_text: I was present at the meeting in the BPRD security pound where I first encountered Johann Kraus.

grounded_facts: Hellboy repeatedly voices discomfort and prejudice regarding Germans, triggered by the introduction of Johann Kraus.
memories.memory_text: I voiced my discomfort around Johann Kraus, saying he's German and that Germans make me nervous.

grounded_facts: Johann Kraus takes Liz's hand and bows, introducing himself in a polite and charming manner.
memories.memory_text: I took Liz's hand and bowed, introducing myself with a polite 'Johann Kraus, at your service,' hoping to make a respectful first impression.

grounded_facts: Hellboy whispers a sarcastic comment about Johann Kraus's 'open face,' mocking his glass bubble head.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Hellboy glowering as I turned toward them, and I heard him whisper, 'That's an open face for you,' which I took as a sarcastic remark about my appearance.

grounded_facts: Johann clarifies his ability to inhabit organic and mechanical entities using protoplasmic emanation, in response to Hellboy's skepticism.
memories.memory_text: I clarified to Hellboy and the others that I can inhabit both organic and mechanical entities using protoplasmic emanation, explaining my ability when they questioned it.

grounded_facts: Johann translates the Fairy's furious babbling into an insult directed at Hellboy, calling him rude, brutish, and not too bright.
memories.memory_text: I translated the Fairy's furious babbling into a clear insult directed at Hellboy, telling him the Fairy called him rude, brutish, and not too bright.

grounded_facts: Through Johann's reactivation, the Fairy recalls a peculiar noise associated with the Troll market, specifically identifying it as Troll language.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the reanimated Fairy recall a peculiar noise from the place where its cage was traded, and I identified that sound as Troll language spoken at the market.

grounded_facts: A focused gathering where Johann reanimates a dead Fairy to extract information about its origins and last known location.
memories.memory_text: I led a focused gathering where I reanimated a dead Fairy to extract information about its origins and last known location, using my protoplasmic emanation to briefly bring it back to life before it collapsed and I reclaimed my ectoplasm.

grounded_facts: Johann uses his protoplasmic emanation to briefly reactivate a dead Fairy's neural system, allowing it to remember and communicate.
memories.memory_text: I used my protoplasmic emanation to reactivate the dead Fairy's neural system, allowing it to remember and communicate before it died again.

grounded_facts: After recalling the clue, the Fairy collapses and dies due to Johann losing control over its limbic system.
memories.memory_text: I lost control over the Fairy's limbic system, and after it gave up the clue, I saw it collapse—I felt my ectoplasm retreat back to my fingertips as its body failed.

grounded_facts: Based on the Fairy's memory and Johann's knowledge, the team concludes they have enough information to pursue the Troll market.
memories.memory_text: I told the team that in my mind, we had enough to go by to pursue the Troll market.

grounded_facts: Hellboy questions Johann's claimed German origin due to his lack of a German accent.
memories.memory_text: Hellboy questioned my German origin by asking why I don't have a funny accent, but I didn't feel the need to justify myself.

grounded_facts: Johann Kraus steps forward to address the hostile crowd and media, attempting to regain control of the situation.
memories.memory_text: I stepped forward and told the others I would handle the situation, confronting the hostile crowd and media myself.

grounded_facts: Hellboy prepares to attack the crowd after being hit and insulted, but is stopped by Liz.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy get hit by an egg and start to react, preparing to attack the crowd, but I watched as Liz stepped in and stopped him physically.

grounded_facts: Liz physically and verbally stops Hellboy from attacking the crowd, urging restraint.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz tell Hellboy to stay calm and give the situation a chance, using her voice to urge restraint while she held him back from attacking the crowd.

grounded_facts: Johann's address is picked up and replayed by media outlets around the world, reaching a wide audience.
memories.memory_text: I addressed the crowd and the news teams, speaking about the BPRD's silent service and the unrecognized sacrifices of our heroes, and later saw that my words were being broadcast in TV vans, homes, pubs, and bars around the world.

grounded_facts: Johann delivers an emotional speech appealing for recognition and respect for the BPRD's sacrifices.
Johann publicly discloses the long-standing, unrecognized service and sacrifices of the BPRD to protect humanity.
memories.memory_text: I delivered a speech in which I shared how the BPRD has served in silence for decades, revealing our unrecognized sacrifices so the public could understand the cost of their safety and might finally grant us respect.

grounded_facts: Johann emotionally requests respect and a chance to prove worth, directing his appeal to the public and reporters.
Johann delivers an emotional speech requesting respect and a chance to prove himself and his team worthy of a place in the world, marking a pivotal moment of vulnerability and advocacy.
memories.memory_text: I stood before the public and reporters, my voice trembling as I asked for respect and the chance to prove myself and my team worthy of a place in this world, choking back tears as I spoke.

grounded_facts: A public gathering on the Brooklyn Bridge where Johann addresses reporters and the public, likely to present the team's role and seek legitimacy.
memories.memory_text: I remember the lights reflecting off my glass head as I addressed the crowd gathered on the Brooklyn Bridge, aware that this moment was our chance to be seen and heard.

grounded_facts: Hellboy mocks Johann's speech as corny, but is stunned when the audience, including teammates, applauds Johann's words.
memories.memory_text: I delivered my speech, asking the public for a little respect and a chance to prove we belong, and though Hellboy mocked it as corny, I saw him and the others—Liz, Abe, even the reporters—applaud afterward, which stunned me.

grounded_facts: Abe expresses admiration for Johann's speech, specifically noting his voice, indicating personal approval.
memories.memory_text: I was told Abe admired my voice, saying 'He has a nice voice,' which surprised me but felt like a small moment of acceptance.

grounded_facts: After the emotional moment, Johann shifts focus back to the mission, signaling a return to operational mode.
memories.memory_text: After that emotional moment, I reminded the team we had work to do, bringing us back to the mission at hand.

memories.memory_text: I stopped Hellboy from breaking the lock because I knew we'd never get in if it was destroyed.
