grounded_facts: Hellboy defeats the Berserker creature with a single uppercut, sending it flying and removing its iron shoes.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy deliver a single powerful uppercut that sent the Berserker flying and knocked its iron shoes off.

grounded_facts: Hellboy physically slaps the shop owner to force him to talk.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Hellboy grab the shop owner and slap him violently to force him to talk.

grounded_facts: Under coercion from Hellboy, the shop owner reveals rumors of a revolt against the human world.
memories.memory_text: I heard the shop owner, under coercion from Hellboy, tell us there were rumors of a revolt against the human world.

grounded_facts: The Princess purchases a silver and crystal cylinder from a map and print shop using a gold bracelet.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that the Princess bought a silver and crystal cylinder from a map and print shop by trading a gold bracelet, though I wasn't inside and only pieced it together from what I observed.

grounded_facts: Hellboy and Johann break into the map shop, destroying the door and defeating the guards.
memories.memory_text: I burst in with Hellboy, leaping over the fallen guards as we stormed the shop.

grounded_facts: Abe is detained and questioned by Princess Nuala in a locked map shop before being rescued.
memories.memory_text: I burst into the map shop with Hellboy, leaping over fallen guards to rescue Abe.

grounded_facts: Hellboy bursts in violently, destroying the door and defeating the guards, undermining the diplomatic tone.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy destroy the door and take down the guards, and I heard someone shout at him to apologize, saying we were in the presence of royalty.

grounded_facts: Abe wakes up in a map shop and realizes his belt is missing; the Princess reveals her guards took his weapons.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe wake up missing his belt, and when Red hesitated, I questioned Mr. Sapien about vouching for the Princess after her guards took Abe's weapons.

grounded_facts: Abe tells Johann that he fully trusts the Princess and confirms her noble origin.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Abe that he fully trusts the Princess and that she's from an ancient, noble line.

grounded_facts: Johann acknowledges the Princess but refuses to accept her claim without proof, producing the Ancient Seal.
memories.memory_text: I acknowledged the Princess but refused to accept her claim without proof, stating her warrior lineage and producing the Ancient Seal.

grounded_facts: The Princess lights a candle and closely inspects the ancient seal brought from the human side.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Princess light a candle and closely inspect the ancient seal she had brought from the human side.

grounded_facts: The Princess demands to know where Hellboy obtained the ancient seal.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Princess demand from Hellboy where he had obtained the ancient seal.

grounded_facts: The Princess explains that the seal was historically used as a declaration of war, signaling the awakening of the Golden Army.
memories.memory_text: I was told that the seal was used in ancient times as a declaration of war, signaling the awakening of the Golden Army.

grounded_facts: Johann reacts with dread, confirming his long-held fear that the Golden Army may be returning.
memories.memory_text: I felt dread rise within me and confirmed aloud that I had long feared the Golden Army might be returning.

grounded_facts: Hellboy turns to Johann, urgently asking for clarification about the Golden Army and whether it involves a goblin army.
memories.memory_text: Hellboy turned to me and urgently asked if the Golden Army meant a goblin army, looking to me for answers.

grounded_facts: A gathering in the Mapmakers Vestibule where the team discusses the significance of the ancient seal.
memories.memory_text: I was part of the discussion in the Mapmakers Vestibule where we learned the ancient seal was once used as a declaration of war, signaling the awakening of the Golden Army, and that it dates back to the dawn of time, even before the great flood.

grounded_facts: The Princess shows her piece of the crown hanging from a chain around her neck.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Princess hold up her piece of the crown, dangling from a chain around her neck, and I focused on it, realizing this was a key to everything.

grounded_facts: A gathering in the mapmaker's shop at night where the Princess shares critical information about the crown and the Golden Army.
memories.memory_text: I was in the mapmaker's shop at night when the Princess shared the story about the crown and the Golden Army, and I looked at Hellboy afterward, sensing the weight of what we'd just learned.

grounded_facts: The Princess reveals that her father destroyed the crown and split it into three pieces.
memories.memory_text: I was told by the Princess that her father had the crown destroyed and split into three pieces—one for mankind and two for the sons of the Earth—and I remember her words clearly as she spoke them to us.

grounded_facts: The Princess reveals that the cylinder contains a map to the Golden Army.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Princess say that the location of the Golden Army is contained within the cylinder she presented.

grounded_facts: The Princess opens the cylinder and presents the parchment with coordinates.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Princess open the cylinder and take out a parchment, which she then showed to us.

grounded_facts: The Princess shows a map with three coordinates: Edo (Tokyo), Moscow, and Renvyle.
memories.memory_text: I saw the map on the parchment showing three coordinates: Edo, which is the old name for Tokyo, Moscow, and Renvyle.

grounded_facts: The Prince publicly labels the Princess as a traitor in front of the crowd, undermining her legitimacy and aligning her with human betrayal.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The Prince publicly labels the Princess as a traitor in front of the crowd, undermining her legitimacy and aligning her with human betrayal.

grounded_facts: The Prince demands allegiance from the creatures by threatening death to those who do not join him in fighting humans.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The Prince demands allegiance from the creatures by threatening death to those who do not join him in fighting humans.

grounded_facts: A public confrontation initiated by the Prince at the stair exit of the troll market, where he denounces the Princess as a traitor and demands allegiance from the creatures.
memories.memory_text: I remember that A public confrontation initiated by the Prince at the stair exit of the troll market, where he denounces the Princess as a traitor and demands allegiance from the creatures.

grounded_facts: The Prince appears at the top of the stairs with his elite guard, blocks the group's path, accuses the Princess of treason, and calls for creatures to join him against humans under threat of death.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The Prince appears at the top of the stairs with his elite guard, blocks the group's path, accuses the Princess of treason, and calls for creatures to join him against humans under threat of death.

grounded_facts: Hellboy cracks his knuckles and stretches, signaling his readiness to fight after the Prince's threat.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy crack his knuckles and stretch his neck, clearly signaling he was ready to fight after the Prince's threat.

grounded_facts: A chaotic battle erupts in the street involving BPRD team, troll market denizens, and supernatural forces.
memories.memory_text: I was caught in the middle of a chaotic street battle involving the BPRD team and various troll market denizens, overwhelmed by the clash of supernatural forces around us.

grounded_facts: Liz uses a prism from the Schufftein goggles to show the camera the truth that the old lady is actually Wink in disguise.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Liz used a prism from the Schufftein goggles to reveal the old lady was actually Wink in disguise, though I didn't see it directly—things were chaotic, and I was focused on taking cover and fighting back.

grounded_facts: Hellboy overpowers Wink, who was disguised as an old lady, and removes his iron mace, throwing it away.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy overpower Wink, who had been disguised as an old lady, and rip the iron mace from his grasp before throwing it aside.

grounded_facts: Hellboy challenges the Elemental to a fight, diverting its attention from the Princess and others.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy step forward and challenge the Elemental, humorously striking a kung fu pose like Bruce Lee to draw its attention away from the others.

grounded_facts: Abe leads the Princess away from the danger zone as the Elemental attacks.
memories.memory_text: I watched Abe calmly approach the Princess and lead her away from danger, offering her his arm to escort her to safety.

grounded_facts: Johann indicates he has a plan and looks at Abe, implying coordination.
memories.memory_text: I indicated that I had a plan and looked at Abe, signaling that I needed him to coordinate with me on the next move.

grounded_facts: Abe informs Hellboy via radio that the Princess is safe.
memories.memory_text: I heard Abe tell Hellboy over the radio that the Princess is fine.

grounded_facts: Johann communicates through the radio, directing Hellboy to lead the Elemental to the bridge.
memories.memory_text: I directed Hellboy over the radio to lead the Elemental to the bridge.

grounded_facts: Hellboy climbs a neon sign reading 'Hotel' to gain higher ground after the Elemental destroys part of it.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy climb the '0' of the neon sign after the Elemental smashed part of it to get to higher ground.

grounded_facts: The Prince mocks Hellboy for failing to kill the Elemental and urges him to join their cause.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Prince mock Hellboy from the tower, calling out, 'Haven't you managed to kill it yet? You, who were so eager for a fight?' and later urging him to join their cause.

grounded_facts: A heavy steel cable is launched from the construction site machinery and splashed down near the Manhattan shore to create a barrier for the Elemental.
memories.memory_text: I saw the heavy steel cable launch from the machine and splash down near the Manhattan shore, tightening around the Elemental's ankles to form a barrier.

grounded_facts: While securing the cable, Abe is pulled under the river and knocked unconscious after hitting a sunken truck, sustaining a head wound.
memories.memory_text: I saw the cable tighten around the Elemental’s ankles after I brought it to life, but I wasn’t sure what happened to Abe—I only inferred he must have been pulled under and hurt when he didn’t resurface.

grounded_facts: Johann instructs Liz to burn the Elemental's roots to weaken it during the fight.
memories.memory_text: I told Liz to burn the roots of the Elemental to weaken it during the fight.

grounded_facts: Liz burns the Elemental's roots while Johann uses the cable to trip it, causing it to lose balance and throw Hellboy into the air.
memories.memory_text: I used the cable to trip the Elemental while I saw Liz burn its roots, causing it to lose balance and throw Hellboy into the air.

grounded_facts: Johann takes over operating the cable machine when Abe cannot figure out the controls.
memories.memory_text: I took over the cable machine when Abe couldn't get it working, plunging my arms into the mechanism to bring it to life and control the steel cable.

grounded_facts: Hellboy strikes the Elemental from behind, causing it to fall forward and impale itself on a bridge spire, killing it and seemingly killing the Prince as well.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy swing back onto the Elemental's back and strike it from behind with his stone fist, making it fall forward and impale itself on the bridge spire, which seemed to kill both the creature and the Prince.

grounded_facts: After the Elemental's death, its branches spread rapidly, covering parts of the city in trees, grass, and moss.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the Elemental's body giving way to rapid growth, its branches spreading over the city and covering entire blocks in trees, grass, and moss.

grounded_facts: A battle unfolds at the Brooklyn Bridge construction site as the team confronts the Elemental and the Prince, culminating in the creature's defeat and environmental transformation.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the full battle at the construction site, where we defeated the Elemental and the Prince, and afterward, I embraced Abe and Liz, relieved we all made it through alive.

grounded_facts: Abe emerges from the river, injured but alive, and is embraced by Liz and Johann in a moment of relief and joy.
memories.memory_text: I embraced Abe and Liz tightly as he emerged from the river, injured but alive, and I felt overwhelming relief and joy at seeing him survive.

grounded_facts: After the battle, Abe and the Princess exchange a meaningful look, indicating mutual affection.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe exchange a meaningful look with the Princess, and I inferred they shared a quiet moment of affection.

grounded_facts: Hellboy watches the joyful reunion from a distance, feeling jealous and alone.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Hellboy standing apart from us, watching the reunion, and I could see he felt jealous and alone.

grounded_facts: Hellboy fires multiple shots at a target, resulting in a ragged and loose bullet pattern around the bullseye.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy fire multiple shots at the target, and the pattern was ragged and loose around the bullseye.

grounded_facts: Johann advises Hellboy that he takes too long to aim and should instead point quickly and intuitively.
memories.memory_text: I advised Hellboy that he takes too long to aim and should just point quickly and intuitively, like wishing for something.

grounded_facts: Hellboy responds sarcastically to Johann's advice by saying 'Oh, I wish for something,' implying frustration or mockery.
memories.memory_text: I heard Hellboy respond to my advice with sarcasm, saying 'Oh, I wish for something.'

grounded_facts: A session at the firing range where Hellboy and Johann test their shooting skills and exchange feedback.
memories.memory_text: I was with Hellboy at the firing range, where we tested our shooting and exchanged feedback.

grounded_facts: Johann reveals his target with a tight, precise cluster of shots dead center, showcasing his superior speed and accuracy.
memories.memory_text: I showed my target with a tight cluster of shots dead center to demonstrate my precision and speed.

grounded_facts: While reaching for his own loader, Johann accidentally knocks Hellboy's loader onto the floor, causing tension.
memories.memory_text: I reached for my loader and accidentally knocked Hellboy's onto the floor.

grounded_facts: Hellboy reacts angrily to Johann knocking over his loader, stating that Johann is winding him up and that he doesn't like it.
memories.memory_text: I heard Hellboy react angrily, saying I was winding him up and he didn't like it after I knocked over his loader.

grounded_facts: Hellboy explicitly forbids Johann from interacting with Liz, asserting dominance and expressing possessiveness.
memories.memory_text: I remember Hellboy telling me, 'From now on, you don't come near her. You don't talk to her,' and later shouting, 'You don't give me sh—' as a clear warning to stay away from Liz.

grounded_facts: Johann mocks Hellboy's slowness in both speech and combat, provoking physical retaliation.
memories.memory_text: I mocked Hellboy's slow fighting style, telling him I'd seen how sluggish he is in combat.

grounded_facts: Hellboy strikes Johann with his stone fist, causing Johann's glass cranium to shatter and his ectoplasmic form to disengage from the suit.
memories.memory_text: I felt Hellboy's stone fist hit my head, shattering my glass cranium, and then I disengaged from my suit as my ectoplasmic form broke free.

grounded_facts: A tense verbal and physical exchange between Hellboy and Johann occurs in the locker room, triggered by Hellboy's jealousy and culminating in violence and supernatural retaliation.
memories.memory_text: I was standing at the mirror polishing my head when Hellboy came up behind me, raised his stone fist, and shattered my cranium—I felt my suit collapse as I left it, and then I used the lockers to strike back, showing him how slow he really is.

grounded_facts: After being attacked, Johann uses both supernatural capability and sarcasm to assert intellectual and tactical superiority over Hellboy.
memories.memory_text: After Hellboy mocked me, I used my abilities and told him, 'See? Speed is the key,' to assert my intellectual and tactical superiority.

grounded_facts: After being struck, Johann's spirit escapes through lockers and reassembles, showcasing his speed and intangible nature as a response to Hellboy's aggression.
memories.memory_text: I felt the impact and immediately escaped my suit, flowing through the lockers before reassembling my form to show my speed and intangible nature.

grounded_facts: Liz admits to Johann that she may have made a mistake, hinting at doubts about her relationship with Hellboy.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Liz that she might have made a mistake, and she admitted that being with Hellboy isn't always easy.

grounded_facts: Johann empathizes with Liz about the difficulties of loving someone like Hellboy, drawing on his own past to offer understanding.
memories.memory_text: I told Liz that loving someone like Hellboy is never easy, but I know he has a good heart and means well—I've been there.

grounded_facts: Johann shares with Liz that he was once married and only realized the significance of his wife after her death, which transformed his life and led him to become who he is today.
memories.memory_text: I shared with Liz how I was once married, and only after losing my wife did I realize how much she meant to me; I tried to reach her in life, but it was only on the Ethereal plane that I saw her again, and that loss shaped who I am today.

grounded_facts: Liz responds to Johann's expression of grief by placing her hand on his shoulder and leaning her head on him, offering silent emotional support.
memories.memory_text: I felt Liz place her hand on my shoulder and lean her head against me, offering silent comfort after I shared my pain.

grounded_facts: Johann confesses to Liz his enduring grief over losing someone significant, linking emotional vulnerability to care and connection.
Johann shares his profound sense of loss with Liz, emphasizing how vulnerability enables care, and urges her not to give up on someone she cares about.
memories.memory_text: I confessed to Liz about my infinite loss and how the threat of loss makes us vulnerable, makes us care, and I urged her not to give up on someone she loves because without that connection, I became an empty shell.

grounded_facts: Johann warns Hellboy that suggesting a romantic relationship with Liz could be unwise, citing public reaction.
memories.memory_text: I warned Hellboy that hinting at a romantic relationship with Liz during the public appearance could be unwise, because of how the public might react.

grounded_facts: The team is being prepped in the green room for an upcoming public appearance, with makeup artists assessing their looks.
memories.memory_text: I was in the green room where the team was being prepped for the public appearance, and I noticed the makeup artists assessing everyone's looks.

grounded_facts: Hellboy resists Johann's advice about his relationship with Liz, asserting his own judgment.
memories.memory_text: I saw that Hellboy resisted my advice about his relationship with Liz, and he told me he would decide for himself, saying it was a love story the public would enjoy.

grounded_facts: Johann reveals to Hellboy that he knew his father and considered him a friend, which surprises Hellboy and implies a deeper history.
memories.memory_text: I told Hellboy that I knew his father and considered him a friend.

grounded_facts: Johann announces he will not participate in the upcoming appearance and instead will watch from the truck lab.
memories.memory_text: I announced to the team that I wouldn't be going on stage and said I'd be watching from the truck lab instead, where I belong.

grounded_facts: Hellboy and Manning discover the bodies of several dead agents on the loading dock.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Hellboy and Manning discovered the bodies of several dead agents on the loading dock because we all rushed into the building right after they would have found them.

grounded_facts: Hellboy, Abe, Liz, and Johann rush past Manning and enter the building.
memories.memory_text: I rushed past Manning with Hellboy, Abe, and Liz, entering the building to respond to the emergency.

grounded_facts: Manning and Hellboy arrive at the BPRD garage in Hummers amid ringing alarms.
An emergency situation unfolds at the BPRD garage involving alarms and dead agents.
memories.memory_text: I arrived with the team at the BPRD garage in the Hummers while alarms were ringing, and I saw the emergency unfolding as we rushed in.

grounded_facts: Johann suggests that Hellboy use a flail from the broken display case to gain advantage in combat.
memories.memory_text: I urged Hellboy to arm himself with the flail from the broken display case during the fight, hoping it would give him the edge he needed.

grounded_facts: During the fight, the Prince stabs Hellboy in the chest with his spear, breaking off the blade and causing severe injury.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Prince yank his spear, breaking the blade inside Hellboy, and I helped catch him as he collapsed.

grounded_facts: Hellboy confronts the Prince directly, initiating a duel to de-escalate the standoff and protect the others.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Hellboy step forward and confront the Prince directly, drawing the fight away from the others; I saw him dodge, strike, and momentarily turn toward Abe before the Prince broke the spear and Hellboy collapsed, which is when Liz and I rushed to catch him.

grounded_facts: After escaping, the Prince declares that the Princess will remain in his possession unless the crown is delivered to him.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Prince declare that the Princess would remain in his possession unless we delivered the crown to him.

grounded_facts: After wounding Hellboy, the Prince takes the Princess and flees with his trolls, issuing a ransom demand for her return.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Prince wound Hellboy and take the Princess before fleeing with his trolls, and I helped catch Hellboy as he collapsed.

grounded_facts: Liz turns to Johann, insisting they must take action to save HB.
memories.memory_text: Liz turned to me, shouting that we had to do something, and I felt the urgency in her voice as she insisted we take action to save HB.

grounded_facts: The team decides they must find the Prince or someone who can reverse the magic on the spear.
memories.memory_text: I heard the team decide that we must find the Prince or someone who can reverse the magic on the spear, knowing it was our only chance.

grounded_facts: Liz insists on going after the Prince to force him to reverse the spell.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Liz that we should go after the Prince and force him to reverse the spell, her anger clear as she called him a son-of-a-bitch.

grounded_facts: Johann states that the Prince will demand the gold piece in exchange for help.
memories.memory_text: I stated that the Prince would demand the gold piece in exchange for his help, knowing it was the price he’d likely ask for.

grounded_facts: Liz declares they should find and give the gold piece to the Prince if needed.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz declare that if needed, we should find the gold piece and give it to the Prince, no hesitation in her voice.

grounded_facts: Agent Agate reports multiple ongoing supernatural incidents worldwide, indicating widespread chaos.
memories.memory_text: I inferred from what I heard that chaos is spreading worldwide due to multiple supernatural events.

grounded_facts: Agent Agate verbally reports the global supernatural incidents to Johann.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Agent Agate about the global supernatural incidents he reported.

grounded_facts: A real-time emergency briefing in the BPRD control room where global supernatural crises are being monitored and reported.
Johann arrives in the BPRD control room and observes multiple global crises displayed on screens and a map.
memories.memory_text: I walked into the control room and saw crises unfolding on every screen—Yeti in Nebraska, a plesiosaurus in Scotland, a lupgarou in Picadilly—and as I looked at the map, LED indicators kept flashing on across the globe, dozens every second, showing how widespread the emergencies had become.

grounded_facts: Johann concludes that the Rebellion is spreading too quickly and that the only way to stop it is to stop the Prince.
memories.memory_text: I concluded that the Rebellion is spreading too quickly and that the only way to stop it is to stop the Prince.

grounded_facts: Abe uses the cylinder case to reveal previously invisible glyphs, coordinates, and a silhouette of a twisted tree on the map, identifying Renvyle as the birthplace of the Princess and her brother.
memories.memory_text: I watched Abe use the cylinder case to reveal hidden glyphs, coordinates, and a twisted tree silhouette on the map, and I heard him say that Renvyle was the birthplace of both the Princess and her brother.

grounded_facts: A formal meeting in the conference room where the team discusses the map and next steps regarding the mission and Hellboy's fate.
memories.memory_text: I was part of the meeting where we discussed the mission and Hellboy's fate, and I told Liz that we couldn't take the chance, even if it was his destiny, which made her glare at me before she said goodbye.

grounded_facts: After Johann suggests accepting Hellboy's possible fate, Liz accuses him of betrayal, welcomes him to the team sarcastically, and exits the room.
Liz responds to Johann's acceptance of Hellboy's possible fate with sarcasm and condemnation, accusing him of betrayal.
memories.memory_text: I suggested that Hellboy's fate might be unavoidable, and Liz glared at me before saying sarcastically, 'Welcome to the team, Johann. And goodbye,' accusing me of betrayal before she left the room.

grounded_facts: Liz confronts Johann upon his arrival, preemptively telling him not to interfere with their plans.
memories.memory_text: I entered the cockpit and heard Liz tell me not to try to stop them.

grounded_facts: Johann announces that he has reconsidered and believes they can proceed to save Hellboy, citing the Prince's lack of the gold crown as a key strategic advantage.
Johann counters Liz's warning by affirming he does not intend to stop them and instead offers a plan to save Hellboy.
memories.memory_text: I told the group I had reconsidered and that we could save Hellboy because the Prince lacks the gold crown, which means his army poses no threat—I made it clear I wasn't there to stop them, but to help.

grounded_facts: Abe attempts to read the manual and operate the plane but ultimately gives up, admitting he cannot pilot it.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe struggling with the manual and heard him admit that he couldn't pilot the plane.

grounded_facts: A group discussion and coordination effort taking place in the cockpit as the team prepares to depart and decide their next move.
memories.memory_text: I entered the cockpit and greeted the team, then took the co-pilot seat and connected with the controls as we prepared to depart.

grounded_facts: Johann sits in the co-pilot seat and connects with the controls, successfully starting the engines.
memories.memory_text: I sat in the co-pilot seat, connected with the controls, and started the engines, saying I'd give it a try.

grounded_facts: Abe is seen in the cockpit and raises his webbed hand to wave goodbye to those outside.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe in the cockpit and he raised his webbed hand to wave goodbye.

grounded_facts: Abe and Johann exit the cargo plane in Reynville, Ireland, marking their physical arrival at the location.
memories.memory_text: I exited the cargo plane in Reynville, Ireland, arriving alongside Abe.

grounded_facts: Liz urges Abe to try inserting the mapcase into the tree slot, showing urgency and support.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz urge Abe to try inserting the mapcase into the tree slot, her voice full of urgency and support.

grounded_facts: Johann warns Abe to remember the dangers of the world they are about to enter before activating the portal.
memories.memory_text: I warned Abe to remember the dangers of the world we were about to enter before he activated the portal.

grounded_facts: Abe inserts and twists the crystal cylinder containing the map into a roundish slot in the tree, activating the portal.
memories.memory_text: I saw Abe insert and twist the crystal cylinder containing the map into the tree's slot, which triggered the tree to transform into a living archway.

grounded_facts: A coordinated effort at the gnarled tree to activate a portal to the Fairy World using the mapcase as a key.
memories.memory_text: I was there at the gnarled tree with the team, watching as we worked together to activate a portal to the Fairy World using the mapcase as a key.

grounded_facts: The group enters through the activated tree and arrives in the Fairy World, a transformed landscape under perpetual night.
memories.memory_text: I walked with the group through the arch of living tree roots and entered a transformed landscape—a world of perpetual night, glowing with strange colors and twisted forms, unlike anything I had seen before.

grounded_facts: The crow informs the group that the goblin will not want money or ordinary items.
The crow interrupts the negotiation to inform the group that the goblin will not accept monetary or material goods as payment.
memories.memory_text: I was told by the crow that the goblin wouldn't accept money or ordinary items as payment, interrupting our negotiation.

grounded_facts: The goblin swiftly cuts open Hellboy's bandage to expose the embedded speartip in his chest, demanding it as payment for passage.
memories.memory_text: I saw the goblin suddenly leap to Hellboy's side and slash his bandage open with a knife, revealing the speartip stuck in his chest.

grounded_facts: The goblin explicitly demands the speartip embedded in Hellboy's chest as the price for ferrying the group across the inlet.
memories.memory_text: I heard the goblin point at the speartip in Hellboy's chest and demand it as the price for ferrying us across the inlet.

grounded_facts: Liz pushes the goblin away from Hellboy after he exposes the wound, showing protective aggression.
memories.memory_text: I saw Liz rush to Hellboy's side and push the goblin away, ready to fight to protect him.

grounded_facts: After learning the speartip is dangerous to touch, the goblin suggests they must go to the Angel of Death, implying a necessary next step.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the goblin's eyes widen in understanding, and then I heard him say, 'We must go to the Angel of Death,' implying that was our next step.

grounded_facts: The goblin offers to ferry the group across the inlet, initiating the negotiation.
A structured interaction between the group and a goblin ferryman to secure passage across the inlet to Renvyle.
memories.memory_text: I was present when the goblin offered to ferry our group across the inlet to Renvyle, initiating a negotiation that I took part in, even offering my belt as part of the exchange before the goblin mentioned the Angel of DEATH.

grounded_facts: The Angel of Death identifies Hellboy as Anung-un-Rama and claims involvement in his arrival into the world.
memories.memory_text: I was told the Angel of Death recognized Hellboy as Anung-un-Rama and claimed she helped bring him into the world in her own way.

grounded_facts: The Angel of Death cautions Liz that saving Hellboy will bring great sorrow to her and the world, referencing his apocalyptic destiny.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Angel of Death warn Liz that saving Hellboy would bring great sorrow to her and the world, and I remember Liz defiantly accepting that future.

grounded_facts: A formal and ritualistic healing conducted by the Angel of Death in her cave, involving the removal of a cursed spear from Hellboy’s body.
memories.memory_text: I was told about the ritual healing in the cave, where the Angel of Death removed the cursed spear from Hellboy’s body with tongs, causing him pain, and then held up the bloody tip with distaste.

grounded_facts: The Goblin signals insistently for its payment after ferrying the group, prompting Johann to interpret its intent.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Goblin jumping and hissing, pointing at the spear tip, so I realized our ferry captain wanted his payment.

grounded_facts: The Angel of Death tosses the extracted spear tip to the Goblin, fulfilling its role as ferry captain and payment recipient.
memories.memory_text: I watched the Angel of Death toss the spear tip to the Goblin, who caught it and ran off.

grounded_facts: The Angel of Death removes the spear tip embedded in Hellboy's chest, healing him and allowing him to regain consciousness.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the Angel of Death use red-hot tongs to pull the spear tip from Hellboy's chest, and I saw his eyes flutter open as he regained consciousness.

grounded_facts: Johann leaves the vicinity of the Angel of Death's cave and heads alone toward the second cave.
memories.memory_text: I glanced back at the Angel of Death's cave and struck off on my own toward the second cave.

grounded_facts: Johann announces that he and Abe have found the entrance to the Golden Army's resting place, advancing the plot toward the final confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I told the team that Abe and I had found the entrance to the Golden Army's resting place, and I asked Liz to come with us.

grounded_facts: Johann tells Hellboy to stay behind and rest, implying lack of trust or concern for stability.
memories.memory_text: I told Hellboy he should stay behind and get some rest, because I was concerned about his condition.

grounded_facts: Despite being told to rest, Hellboy insists on joining the mission to the Golden Army, asserting his role in the team.
memories.memory_text: Despite my request, I witnessed Hellboy insist on joining the mission to the Golden Army, reaffirming his commitment to the team.

grounded_facts: Hellboy refuses to be left behind and mocks Johann, asserting his intent to monitor him.
memories.memory_text: Hellboy refused to be left behind and mocked me, asserting he would keep an eye on me.

grounded_facts: The team arrives at the bluff overlooking the sea, identifying the cave entrance half a mile ahead as the target location.
memories.memory_text: I followed the trail along the bluff with Liz and Hellboy, checked the map, and pointed to the cave entrance half a mile ahead, confirming it was our target.

grounded_facts: Abe points to the violent sea and warns Hellboy that they must jump in, questioning if he can make it.
memories.memory_text: I heard Abe point out that the only way in was to jump into the violent sea, and he questioned whether Hellboy could make it.

grounded_facts: Abe and Hellboy express surprise at the absence of expected security at the cave entrance.
memories.memory_text: I heard Abe and Hellboy express surprise about the lack of security at the cave entrance, wondering why there wasn't more protection given the importance of the place.

grounded_facts: Wink ambushes Hellboy with a chain and mace, initiating combat.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Wink ambush Hellboy with a chain and mace, launching the attack without warning and starting the fight.

grounded_facts: Hellboy overpowers Wink, breaks the chain, and throws him off the cliff into the sea.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy overpower Wink, break the chain around his neck, and throw him off the cliff into the sea.

grounded_facts: After the fight, Abe notices Hellboy is bleeding; Hellboy tells him not to say anything and to keep moving.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Hellboy was hurt and trying to hide it when Abe noticed the bleeding and Hellboy told him not to say anything and to keep moving.

grounded_facts: The team approaches and prepares to enter the sea cave leading to the enemy base, encountering an ambush and entering underwater.
memories.memory_text: I plunged into the rough seas, felt my body tumble underwater, and then led Liz and Hellboy down into the dark cave entrance.

grounded_facts: The team enters the sea and swims into the cave entrance underwater.
memories.memory_text: I plunged into the violent sea from the bluff and, after being tumbled by the rough waters, I swam down to lead Liz and Hellboy into the dark cave entrance.

grounded_facts: Hellboy's side wound reopens during or after the fight with Wink.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Hellboy checking his side and saw that his wound had reopened after the fight.

grounded_facts: A coordinated effort by the group to unlock and access a submerged passage leading into the cliff.
memories.memory_text: I remember that A coordinated effort by the group to unlock and access a submerged passage leading into the cliff.

grounded_facts: Hellboy helps Johann unlock an underwater iron lock, enabling access to a hidden stairwell.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Hellboy helps Johann unlock an underwater iron lock, enabling access to a hidden stairwell.

grounded_facts: The trio climbs a hidden stairwell carved into the cliff, moving deeper into the cave system.
memories.memory_text: I climbed the hidden stairwell carved into the cliff with the others, moving deeper into the cave system while using light sticks to see.

grounded_facts: Liz voices worry about Hellboy's condition, indicating the group should rest.
memories.memory_text: I was told to hold up and rest when Liz voiced her concern about Hellboy's condition.

grounded_facts: Hellboy refuses to acknowledge his injury and insists he is fine, pushing past the others.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy refuse to acknowledge his injury, insisting he was fine before pushing past us despite his pain.

grounded_facts: Hellboy's repeated thumping on a mechanical soldier causes it to fall, initiating a chain reaction that topples a line of golden soldiers.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Hellboy's repeated thumping on one of the mechanical soldiers caused it to fall, setting off a chain reaction like dominoes that brought down entire rows of golden soldiers, with another wave crashing toward us shortly after.

grounded_facts: Prince observes Hellboy's wound and comments on it with disdain.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Prince remark on Hellboy's wound, saying he was bleeding and that it was unfortunate, then sneered that machines never bleed and don't feel the zest of combat.

grounded_facts: Prince demands the remaining gold segment, revealing he already has two pieces.
memories.memory_text: I stood with the team when Prince Nuada demanded the remaining gold segment, claiming he already had two pieces; I told him we did not have it, and he called us foolish.

grounded_facts: The BPRD team confronts Prince Nuada in the underground arena after triggering the collapse of golden soldiers.
memories.memory_text: I was examining the weapons on the golden soldiers when Hellboy and Liz barely dodged the collapsing line, and then I saw Prince Nuada appear at the front of the wreckage, circling us while keeping his eyes on me before challenging us with cold words.

grounded_facts: Prince Nuada assembles the crown and declares himself commander, reactivating the entire golden army.
memories.memory_text: I saw Prince Nuada assemble the crown and place it on his head, then command the golden army to rise — I heard him say, 'I am Prince Nuada and I command my army to life once more,' and then the machines awoke and he ordered them to kill.

grounded_facts: Abe arrives with the last gold segment and hands it to Prince Nuada in exchange for the Princess's safety.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Abe arrive with the final gold segment, hand it to Prince Nuada, and then look on in horror as the Prince took the Princess — I realized too late that Abe had given up the piece to save her.

grounded_facts: Johann exits his suit and takes control of a mechanical soldier to fight the others.
memories.memory_text: I exited my suit and flowed into a mechanical soldier, turning it against the others—I chopped through them until I was forced out and had to return to my suit.

grounded_facts: Hellboy formally challenges Prince Nuada for command of the golden army, leading to a sword duel.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Hellboy formally challenge Prince Nuada for command of the golden army, shouting that a challenge must be answered, and then saw the two of them draw swords and begin their duel as the hall echoed with the clash.

grounded_facts: After stabbing herself, the Princess shares a final look with her brother, conveying love and hatred.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the Princess stab herself and then share a final look with her brother, a hard look that somehow held both love and hatred.

grounded_facts: After gaining advantage from Princess's sacrifice, Hellboy disarms Prince and impales him when Prince commits suicide by charging the blade.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy grow weak and falter in his fight against the Prince, but when the Princess made her sacrifice, it gave him the opening he needed—he disarmed the Prince and held him at swordpoint, though I knew then it wasn't over, and when the Prince charged forward onto the blade, I witnessed them both fall, the Prince impaling himself in his final act.

grounded_facts: After being impaled, Prince Nuada dies while delivering a prophetic warning to Hellboy about humanity's betrayal.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Prince Nuada die after he was impaled, and before he turned to dust, I heard him warn Hellboy that humanity would betray him just as they had disappointed others before.

grounded_facts: Hellboy destroys the crown piece by piece, causing the golden army to collapse, and the final segment explodes, destroying the remainder.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy rip the crown apart piece by piece, and with each destruction, divisions of the golden army collapsed until the final explosion wiped out the rest.

grounded_facts: Hellboy orders the troll guards to leave and remain in the shadows.
memories.memory_text: I heard Hellboy order the troll guards to leave and stay in the shadows, where they belong.

grounded_facts: The immediate aftermath following the deaths of Prince and Princess, including the destruction of the crown and army.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy take the crown from Prince Nuada's head, study it, and then tear it apart piece by piece, causing division after division of the golden army to collapse into scrap, until the last segment exploded in his hands and he ordered the remaining beings to leave and stay in the shadows.

grounded_facts: Johann asks Abe if he has any last-minute requests before activating the mechanism, seeking closure or consent.
memories.memory_text: I asked Abe if he had any last-minute requests before I activated the mechanism, wanting to make sure he was ready.

grounded_facts: Abe expresses quiet readiness to leave his current state or existence and enter the real world, marking a psychological and existential turning point.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Abe that he was ready for the real world when he said, 'Do it, please. I - I'm ready for the real world now.'

grounded_facts: Johann inserts the map cylinder into the slot and turns it, triggering the transformation of the tree roots into an archway.
memories.memory_text: I inserted the map cylinder into the slot and turned it, which caused the tree roots to shift and form an archway that let the team pass through.

grounded_facts: Hellboy removes his pack and declares his resignation, though he keeps his weapon.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy glance at Abe, take out his gun, and shrug off his pack, then say, 'Looks that way, doesn't it?' and add that he'd keep his weapon.

grounded_facts: Johann verbally rebukes Manning for his behavior or attitude toward the departing team members.
memories.memory_text: I called Manning an asshole when he tried to stop the team, because his behavior toward them was unacceptable.

memories.memory_text: I remember the cool weight of the new breathing apparatus fitting snugly against my neck, the sleek design a quiet sign that things were changing—then seeing Hellboy’s photo, grinning mid-leap, and murmuring, 'Oh, Lord—he's smiling in this one.'

I said Hellboy wasn't angry at Manning—just enthusiastic—when the wall suddenly exploded, fire tearing open the door, and I ducked behind the pillar, my voice trailing off as I saw him on the floor, smoking, saying 'Oh, hi Blue.'

I heard a high-pitched chitter-chatter no one else seemed to notice, and when I touched the empty cage with the royal seal, I knew something was very wrong—creatures had escaped, and I could sense them nearby.

I found a human femur—wet and gnawed—right there on the floor. I remember the slick texture, the marks left by sharp teeth. I whispered, 'Ah, I knew it,' because the evidence confirmed what I'd feared.

I noticed the floor wasn't a rug—Red lifted his foot and saw it was thick with excrement. Then it clicked: they digest instantly, excrete quickly, and consume everything. No remains. No corpses. Just this... layer of waste.

Through my goggles, the room shifted—boxes became a tree trunk, iron beams turned to stone columns, and there, where a banner had hung, a massive rusted lock appeared. I said, 'There—' and knew it was the mechanism blocking our way.
I saw her slippered feet first—pearls and gold embroidery glinting in the filth, so out of place among the mud and vermin. That small detail pulled me forward, made me wonder who she could be.

When her cowl fell back, I recognized her—her face, her presence, like light in that wretched place. And then I saw the bracelet on her bandaged arm, the seal's coat of arms unmistakable. I was thunderstruck.

I woke up in that dusty map shop, disoriented, and the first thing I noticed was my belt—my weapons—gone. When she told me her guards had taken them, I felt exposed, vulnerable in a way I hadn’t in years.

She asked me to give her my hand, and when her fingers traced my palm, something stirred—warmth, recognition. Later, even with Red bursting in, I insisted she was no threat, that we should honor her request.

I remember moving like water—ducking and weaving, feeling the rhythm of each strike coming, parrying just enough to redirect the force. It was as if my body remembered the form before my mind could catch up.

I grabbed two bowling balls and rolled them hard at the guards—I heard the impact as they staggered back. When they rose, I snatched up the pins nearby and swung them like clubs, using what the alley gave me.

I remember the way her voice softened as she read Bronte’s words about a string tied beneath the ribs—something in me recognized that feeling, even before she closed the book and I confessed how I’d never known Charlotte, though I wished I had.

When she spoke of sensing her twin brother across distance, of a bond from childhood in Renvyle, I hesitated—but then I believed her, because my own instinct, not logic, told me she was speaking a truth I could not measure.

I told Red I think I'm in love—with the Princess—because she's like me, a creature from another world, and for the first time, I didn't feel alone. I could barely get the words out, stammering like I always do when something matters.

After talking about Father, I sipped beer and said Manilow suddenly made sense to me—then Red and I started singing 'Can't Smile Without You' together, quietly at first, then loud, almost crying. I don't know when I last sang with someone like that.
I opened the hood of the Hummer and said it was an unfortunate vehicle. The waste of precious fossil fuels bothered me.
I stood beside Hellboy and Liz as the applause rose, feeling the weight of so many eyes on us—this was the first time I was introduced by name to the world, not just a hidden figure in the shadows.

I remember the bright lights of the camera turning to me, and how Mr. Leno’s joke about my neck collar made the audience laugh—I chose to speak calmly, explaining my biology as clearly as I could, though my voice trembled slightly with restraint.

I remember the blare of the alarms as we rushed from the Hummer into the garage, the cold concrete beneath my feet, and the sight of fallen agents on the dock—something was very wrong, and we had to move fast.

I saw her—arms bound, held by the hair—and before I could stop myself, I ran toward her. The troll’s claws sliced the air just past my chest, but I didn’t care. She was in pain, and I had to reach her.
I saw her head snap back, heard her moan—and I cried out, 'H.B., no! Stop—you mustn’t harm him!' Only later did I realize: the blow wasn’t meant for her. I mistook her pain for his doing.
I touched the spear with my webbed fingers, and I felt it move—alive, wriggling deeper toward Red’s heart. I had to explain, even though Liz didn’t want to see it.
I found the gold piece hidden in Chapter 23 of *Jane Eyre*, just where I’d left it, but when Liz came in, I closed my hand around it without thinking—then lied to her face.

I moistened the cylinder's surface and pressed it onto the map—suddenly the hidden glyphs appeared, and I saw the name: Renvyle. That was the place, where both royal siblings were born, and where they held something sacred.

I stood there quietly at first, watching Liz come in, her eyes full of tears, and then I found my voice—soft but sure—saying we’d make it alright, that Manning didn’t matter, that it was just the three of us now.

I couldn't remember the procedure, not even the simplest controls—just flipping through the manual, grasping at terms like 'port' and 'NA-7488-BD,' but it was no use. I had to admit it: I can't pilot this thing.
I raised my webbed hand to wave from the cockpit as the plane spun in circles, exhaust fumes filling the hangar, knowing there was no turning back.

I inserted the crystal cylinder into the slot in the tree and twisted it—just as the map suggested—and for a moment, I wasn't sure if anything would happen. Then the roots began to move, rising from the earth like waking serpents.

Through the binoculars, I saw it—a second cave, half-hidden behind the crashing waves along the coast. I noted its position, distinct from the Angel of Death's cave, though I couldn't yet grasp what lay inside.
I remember standing before the twisted tree, my voice barely above a whisper as I said, 'Do it, please. I - I'm ready for the real world now.'
I stepped forward, removed my gunbelt and equipment pack, and handed them to Mr. Manning, telling him I quit—I could see the shock on his face, but I had to leave the BPRD behind.

memories.memory_text: I held the door for Liz, even though she wouldn’t look at me. Just kept it open, like a damn gentleman.

I heard scratching, then Abe's voice crackling over the intercom—more than one, he said, maybe a hundred or two. The wall bulged right in front of me and split open, ceiling cracking too, so I loaded my shotgun fast.
I yanked the pins on the whole belt of Vulcan grenades with those damn tooth fairies crawling all over me—felt the charge build right before the world went white.
I exploded through the window in a fireball, still covered in those shrieking things, and came down hard on the street—felt the pavement crack under me.

I shot those fairies one by one, then held up the last squirming one by its tail—flashes popping all around me, Manning looking like he wanted to vanish. I just shrugged and said, 'I guess we're out now.'
Manning told me Washington wants a new public face for the BPRD, and it’s not me—some guy named Johann Kraus is taking over, a big shot from the European branch.
I saw Kraus in person—his head’s a glass bubble full of gas, and when he bowed to Liz with that smooth voice, all I could think was, 'That’s an open face for you...'
I remember asking Johann, 'What—? What—? A goblin army—?' when the Princess said the seal was a declaration of war, and seeing him sit down like the world just dropped out from under him.

I remember asking where the crown was, and the Princess saying her father had it destroyed—split into three pieces, one for mankind, two for the sons of the Earth. She held up her piece on a chain like it meant something.
She opened that cylinder and showed a map with just three spots—Tokyo, Moscow, Renvyle—no other details. Then she rolled it back up like it was nothing, but I knew it wasn't.
I cracked my knuckles, felt the pop in my fingers, and started up the stairs—those guards weren't going to stop me from getting to him.
I cracked Johann over the head with my stone fist, and his glass head just shattered—didn't expect that. Then his suit collapsed, hissing like a punctured tank.
The lockers came alive, slamming into my head over and over—couldn't even see straight. Johann's voice echoed, saying 'Speed is the key,' while his misty form drifted away.
I told Johann to back off when he tried to tell me how to handle things with Liz—like I need his advice on what to say or who I am.
He said he knew my father—and that my father wouldn't have approved of me. I didn't know what to say, just stood there.

I was just sitting there when Leno asked if the dragon was my friend—like I’m some kind of monster sympathizer. Then he went after me, questioning why I wasn’t out 'protecting humanity' while hitting on American women. That’s when I snapped and tore the desk up, hurling it through the set.
I walked right up to the Prince and told him to start with me—then showed him my fist, calling it Five-fingered Mary. He wanted a fight, so I gave him one.
I punched him hard, knocked him down, but when Abe shouted, I turned—then felt the spear go into my chest. The pain hit like a truck, and the last thing I saw was Liz and Johann rushing toward me.
I'm lying on the table, barely holding on—every time Abe touches the spear, it twists deeper, like it's alive, and I can feel it crawling toward my heart.
I'm leaning in the doorway, barely holding myself up, and the cats are all around me, purring like nothing's wrong—like they don't even notice I'm falling apart.
Abe stands there quiet at first, then says Manning's orders be damned—that we stick together, the three of us. I didn't expect that. Not from him.
I climbed up into the plane and saw Liz smiling at me—just that look, no words, but it hit me like a gut punch after everything that went down.
I remember Johann stepping in when Abe couldn't get the plane going, saying 'I'll give it a try' just before the engines fired up.
I woke up in Liz's arms on the plane, sunlight hitting my face, and all I could manage was to ask where we were—my voice sounded weak, even to me.

I heard that voice—cold, ancient—call me Anung-un-Rama, like it was a name I was supposed to know. Then it said I was meant to rule over the destruction of the Earth, and Liz shouted yes, she still wanted me to live.
I felt the tongs pull the spear out of my chest—white-hot pain—and then I saw her, the Angel of Death, holding up the bloody tip. I opened my eyes, weak, and gave her a faint smile.
I looked at Liz, really looked, and asked her—'Am I a good man, Liz?? Am I??'—because if she didn’t think so, I wasn’t sure I could keep going.
When Johann showed up and told me to stay behind, I called him 'GLASSHOLE' and said I'd be damned before I let him keep me from watching over Liz.

I swung that mace hard into Wink again and again, feeling the impact all the way up my arms, and when I had him close, I lifted him over my head and threw him off the cliff—watching him smash into the rocks below.
After the fight, I felt the warm blood seeping from my side, pressed my hand to the bandage to check it, and said 'Ouch- ouch- ouch-' under my breath before telling Abe to keep quiet and move on.
I grabbed that rusted wheel underwater and forced it open, felt the bandage tear free and blood clouding around me, but I didn’t stop until it gave.
I leaned against the wall on those damn stairs, wiped at my chest, and pushed past them when Liz said to rest—told her I was fine even though every step burned.
I tapped the chest of one of those golden statues just to hear the echo, and when it rocked back, I knew I’d messed up—then the whole damn line started crashing down like dominoes.

After the noise of the falling soldiers died down, another wave came from a different direction—Liz screamed, I yanked her out of the way just in time, and then I saw him: the Prince, standing there like he was waiting for us.
I took off my pack and handed it over, and when Manning started in, I just said, 'Looks that way, doesn't it?'—then grabbed the Samaritan back before walking off with Liz and Abe.
Liz said, 'Our baby, that's who!' and suddenly everything clicked—her smile, the way she breathed deep—and then I was grinning so hard it felt like my face might split.
